# nautobot_namespace (Resource)

Manages an IPAM namespace in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nautobot_namespace" "example" {
  name        = "Production"
  description = "Production IP address space"
}

output "namespace_id" {
  value = nautobot_namespace.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Namespace name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Namespace description.
- `location_id` (String) UUID of the location associated with the namespace.
- `tenant_id` (String) UUID of the tenant associated with the namespace.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Namespace creation date (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Namespace UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A namespace can be imported using its UUID
terraform import nautobot_namespace.example 3b62970b-b2e8-4b9e-aca1-5cd64c840dac
```
